definitions.full: H6283. athereth עֲתֶ֫רֶת noun feminine abundance (Aramaism, si vera lectio); — construct Jer 33:6 I will reveal to them abundance of peace, etc. (corrupt according to Gie Buhl Lex ; Vrss. render variously).
